portfolio.description: Sharpe-optimized: top-4 fleets by avg_pnl/sd_pnl ratio, weighted by Sharpe-proxy. Tilts to per-pick risk-adjusted returns.
portfolio.methodology: Aggregated from ai_tournament_picks_latest.json (resolved WIN/LOSS/TP_HIT/SL_HIT). Eligibility gate: n>=20, WR>=50%, PF>=1.1. Reliability scored by composite = 0.5*Wilson95LB(WR) + 0.3*PF_LB/3 + 0.2*(1-exp(-n/50)). Position weights synthesize paper allocations against $100k starting NAV. NOT promoted to live money; tracked as shadow paper only per CLAUDE.md Goal #1. Variant: top-4 by Sharpe-proxy; sleeves weighted by Sharpe-proxy. Regime-gate suggested at scoring layer; not gated here.
